 CBS Analyst Jill Schlesinger Guides Open Enrollment in Money Matters!!!!! 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Great Day St. Louis welcomes CBS analyst Jill Schlesinger with Money Matters open enrollment tips on health insurance, benefits and ACA costs for 2026!!!! With 150 million Americans buying insurance through jobs, she covers where to start, other benefits to weigh, and ACA open enrollment from Nov. 1. Money Matters sponsored by First Mid Bank and Trust, 1-877-888-5629, First-Mid.com. More at JillOnMoney.com. Great Day
 Will Your Roof Be Ready? National Roofing STL Shares Winter Prep Tips!!!! 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT | By Elizabeth Boaz Great Day St. Louis welcomes National Roofing STL owners Chris and Nicole Richie with winter roof prep tips and free no-obligation inspections today!!!!!! We can't control nature, but Midwest storms test every roof. The owners share what to do now for winter weather and what their free inspection covers. Call 314-808-4270 or visit National-Roofing-STL.com. Great Day
 Coffee Talk: Should Parents Track Kids Every Move? 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT | By Elizabeth Boaz Coffee Talk presented by Carol House Furniture: should parents track kids every move - the hosts debate safety, privacy and trust plus steps, sleep, pets! Location tools can reunite families fast in crowded spots like the City Museum, but constant checks on teens can erode trust. The hosts unpack the Parents Magazine conversation and land on talking it out and setting shared expectations. Great Day
 Emmaus Homes Celebrates 130 Years Helping Adults Live Independently!!!!!! 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT | By Elizabeth Boaz Great Day St. Louis welcomes Emmaus Homes marking 130 years helping adults with disabilities live independently, plus how you can join the team today!!!!! Chief HR Officer Stacy Spradling and Talent Services Specialist Kelly Montgomery share Emmaus' mission in Missouri, Kelly's career journey, and how to start a career. Apply at Emmaus-Homes.org/careers or call 636-534-5200. Great Day
 Chuck Berry Would Have Turned 100: Stars Celebrate with Chuck 100 Concert 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT | By Elizabeth Boaz Great Day St. Louis previews Chuck 100 with Steve Jordan and Charles Berry Jr., celebrating Chuck Berry 100th birthday tomorrow night at the Grandel at 7! Musical director Steve Jordan and Charles Berry Jr. detail the one-night Grandel celebration, the setlist, and the 2027 documentary filming. Tickets at MetroTix.com, proceeds benefit STL.org. Great Day
 Mom Turns Loss of Son Into Lifeline for Kids with the Klos Foundation. 
 Updated : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:02 AM CDT | By Elizabeth Boaz Great Day St. Louis welcomes Sheila Struckmeyer, founder of the Klos Foundation, turning loss of her son into hope and help for struggling kids today. She shares the mission, her story of turning personal loss into hope, and how to help or get help. Reach the Klos Foundation at 636-344-8139 or The-Klos-Foundation.org.
